resources.string: Sync only progress and position within reading data, excluding reading time, bookmarks, and notes. Book files are controlled separately above.

Sync progress for the same book across devices without uploading book files.

First update and manually sync the device with your latest progress, then update and sync your other devices. Use identical book files on each device; existing books do not need to be imported again.

Open WebDAV and tap Sync now. Your current sync choices will be kept.
